examples.en: We had spaghetti with tomato sauce for dinner.
examples.zh: 我們晚餐吃了番茄醬汁義大利麵。

examples.en: Be careful not to overcook the spaghetti.
examples.zh: 小心不要把義大利麵煮過頭。

examples.en: My brother can eat two plates of spaghetti at once.
examples.zh: 我哥哥一次可以吃兩盤義大利麵。

examples.en: Someone stole my bike from the school gate yesterday.
examples.zh: 昨天有人從校門口偷走了我的腳踏車。

examples.en: The young actor stole the show with his funny speech.
examples.zh: 這位年輕演員以風趣的演說搶盡了風頭。

examples.en: She stole a glance at the clock during the exam.
examples.zh: 她在考試時偷瞄了一眼時鐘。

examples.en: At only ten dollars, this jacket is a steal.
examples.zh: 這件外套只要十元，真是太划算了。

examples.en: The tickets were a steal during the sale.
examples.zh: 特價期間這些票非常划算。

examples.en: Our hotel room was a steal for that price.
examples.zh: 以那個價錢來說，我們的飯店房間真是物超所值。

examples.en: Steam rose from the hot cup of tea.
examples.zh: 熱茶杯裡冒出蒸汽。

examples.en: The mirror was covered with steam after my shower.
examples.zh: 我洗完澡後，鏡子蒙上了一層水蒸氣。

examples.en: Old trains used steam to move along the tracks.
examples.zh: 老式火車利用蒸汽沿著軌道前進。

examples.en: Mom likes to steam fish with ginger.
examples.zh: 媽媽喜歡用薑來蒸魚。

examples.en: The soup was steaming when she put it on the table.
examples.zh: 她把湯端上桌時，湯還冒著熱氣。

examples.en: You can steam the vegetables for about five minutes.
examples.zh: 你可以把蔬菜蒸大約五分鐘。

examples.en: I have a pain in my stomach after lunch.
examples.zh: 我午餐後胃痛。

examples.en: Don't go swimming on a full stomach.
examples.zh: 吃飽後不要去游泳。

examples.en: The baby fell asleep on her father's stomach.
examples.zh: 小寶寶趴在爸爸的肚子上睡著了。

senses.zh: 暴風雨的；多風暴的；激烈的

examples.en: It was a dark and stormy night on the island.
examples.zh: 那是島上一個漆黑又有暴風雨的夜晚。

examples.en: The ferry was canceled because of the stormy weather.
examples.zh: 因為天氣有暴風雨，渡輪停駛了。

examples.en: Their stormy talk ended when the teacher came in.
examples.zh: 老師一進來，他們激烈的談話就結束了。

examples.en: Mom is cooking soup on the stove.
examples.zh: 媽媽正在爐子上煮湯。

examples.en: Please turn off the stove before you leave the kitchen.
examples.zh: 離開廚房前請關掉爐火。

examples.en: We bought a gas stove for our new apartment.
examples.zh: 我們為新公寓買了一台瓦斯爐。

examples.en: Can I have a straw for my milk tea?
examples.zh: 我的奶茶可以給我一支吸管嗎？

examples.en: The farmer put some straw in the barn.
examples.zh: 農夫在穀倉裡鋪了一些稻草。

examples.en: She wore a straw hat to the beach.
examples.zh: 她戴著一頂草帽去海灘。

examples.en: A white swan was swimming across the lake.
examples.zh: 一隻白天鵝正游過湖面。

examples.en: The children fed bread to the swan in the park.
examples.zh: 孩子們在公園裡餵天鵝吃麵包。

examples.en: The swan protected her babies from the dog.
examples.zh: 天鵝媽媽保護小天鵝不被狗接近。

examples.en: She has a great talent for music.
examples.zh: 她很有音樂天分。

examples.en: The school holds a talent show every December.
examples.zh: 學校每年十二月都會舉辦才藝表演。

examples.en: Our company is looking for young talent.
examples.zh: 我們公司正在尋找年輕的人才。

examples.en: My uncle is very talkative at family dinners.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在家庭聚餐時非常健談。

examples.en: She is shy at school but talkative at home.
examples.zh: 她在學校很害羞，在家卻很愛說話。

examples.en: The talkative driver told us about the city's history.
examples.zh: 那位健談的司機向我們介紹了這座城市的歷史。

examples.en: I peeled a tangerine and shared it with my sister.
examples.zh: 我剝了一顆橘子和妹妹分著吃。

examples.en: These tangerines are sweet and full of juice.
examples.zh: 這些橘子又甜又多汁。

examples.en: We put a tangerine on the table for the holiday.
examples.zh: 我們在桌上擺了一顆橘子當作節日裝飾。

examples.en: The fish tank needs cleaning every week.
examples.zh: 魚缸每個星期都需要清洗。

examples.en: Dad filled the gas tank before the long trip.
examples.zh: 爸爸在長途旅行前把油箱加滿了油。

examples.en: A large water tank stands on the roof.
examples.zh: 屋頂上放著一個大水塔。

examples.en: We put up the tent beside the river.
examples.zh: 我們在河邊搭起了帳篷。

examples.en: Four people can sleep in this tent.
examples.zh: 這頂帳篷可以讓四個人睡。

examples.en: It rained all night, but the tent stayed dry.
examples.zh: 雨下了一整晚，但帳篷裡面還是乾的。

examples.en: You did a terrific job on your science project.
examples.zh: 你的自然科學專題做得非常棒。

examples.en: We had a terrific time at the beach.
examples.zh: 我們在海邊玩得非常開心。

examples.en: There was a terrific noise outside the window.
examples.zh: 窗外傳來一陣極大的噪音。

examples.en: The baby sucked her thumb while she slept.
examples.zh: 小寶寶睡覺時吸著她的大拇指。

examples.en: He hurt his thumb while closing the door.
examples.zh: 他關門時弄傷了大拇指。

examples.en: The teacher smiled and raised her thumb at my answer.
examples.zh: 老師笑著對我的答案豎起了大拇指。

examples.en: We climbed to the top of the tower to see the city.
examples.zh: 我們爬到塔頂俯瞰整座城市。

examples.en: The clock tower is the oldest building in town.
examples.zh: 鐘塔是這個小鎮最古老的建築。

examples.en: A tall office tower stands next to the station.
examples.zh: 車站旁邊矗立著一棟高聳的辦公大樓。

examples.en: The mountain towers over the small village.
examples.zh: 這座山高聳在小村莊上方。

examples.en: My brother towers over everyone in his class.
examples.zh: 我弟弟比班上的每個人都高出一大截。

examples.en: Tall buildings tower above the narrow street.
examples.zh: 高樓高聳在狹窄的街道上方。

examples.en: The police traced the call to a public phone.
examples.zh: 警方查出這通電話是從公共電話打的。

examples.en: Students traced the map onto thin paper.
examples.zh: 學生們把地圖描到薄紙上。

examples.en: She traced her family history back four hundred years.
examples.zh: 她把家族歷史追溯到四百年前。

examples.en: There was no trace of the missing cat.
examples.zh: 那隻走失的貓一點蹤跡也沒有。

examples.en: The sauce has a trace of lemon in it.
examples.zh: 這個醬汁裡有一點點檸檬味。

examples.en: The snow left no trace of his footsteps.
examples.zh: 雪地裡沒有留下他的腳印。

examples.en: He plays the trumpet in the school band.
examples.zh: 他在學校樂隊裡吹小號。

examples.en: The sound of the trumpet filled the hall.
examples.zh: 小號的聲音響遍了禮堂。

examples.en: My cousin bought a new trumpet for his birthday.
examples.zh: 我表哥買了一支新小號當作生日禮物。

examples.en: The baby loves to play in the tub.
examples.zh: 小寶寶很愛在浴缸裡玩水。

examples.en: She bought a tub of ice cream for the party.
examples.zh: 她為派對買了一桶冰淇淋。

examples.en: Put the dirty clothes in the plastic tub.
examples.zh: 把髒衣服放進塑膠盆裡。

examples.en: The train passed through a long tunnel.
examples.zh: 火車穿過一條很長的隧道。

examples.en: Cars slow down when they enter the tunnel.
examples.zh: 車子進入隧道時會減速。

examples.en: The workers dug a new tunnel under the river.
examples.zh: 工人在河底挖了一條新的隧道。

examples.en: Workers will tunnel through the mountain next year.
examples.zh: 工人明年將在山中挖一條隧道。

examples.en: The rabbit tunneled under the fence.
examples.zh: 兔子在柵欄底下挖洞穿了過去。

examples.en: They plan to tunnel beneath the bay.
examples.zh: 他們計畫在海灣底下開鑿隧道。

examples.en: Pack enough underwear for the three-day trip.
examples.zh: 為這趟三天的旅行多帶幾件內衣褲。

examples.en: He bought new underwear at the department store.
examples.zh: 他在百貨公司買了新的內褲。

examples.en: Please put your underwear in the laundry basket.
examples.zh: 請把你的內衣褲放進洗衣籃。

examples.en: Every snowflake has a unique shape.
examples.zh: 每一片雪花都有獨特的形狀。

examples.en: This café offers a unique view of the harbor.
examples.zh: 這間咖啡廳能欣賞到海港獨一無二的景色。

examples.en: The panda is unique to this part of China.
examples.zh: 貓熊是中國這個地區特有的動物。

examples.en: He wore a gray vest over his white shirt.
examples.zh: 他在白襯衫外面穿了一件灰色背心。

examples.en: Cyclists should wear a bright vest at night.
examples.zh: 騎自行車的人在夜間應該穿著顯眼的背心。

examples.en: Mom knitted a warm vest for my grandfather.
examples.zh: 媽媽為我爺爺織了一件保暖的背心。

examples.en: Reading books will build your vocabulary.
examples.zh: 閱讀書籍可以增加你的字彙量。

examples.en: Our teacher gives us a vocabulary test every Friday.
examples.zh: 我們老師每個星期五都會給我們字彙測驗。

examples.en: The article uses simple vocabulary that beginners can follow.
examples.zh: 這篇文章用的是初學者也看得懂的簡單詞彙。

examples.en: We play volleyball on the beach every summer.
examples.zh: 我們每年夏天都在沙灘上打排球。

examples.en: The volleyball team won the school championship.
examples.zh: 排球隊贏得了校內冠軍。

examples.en: Can you lend me your volleyball for the game?
examples.zh: 你可以把你的排球借我比賽用嗎？

examples.en: She wears a silver watch on her left wrist.
examples.zh: 她的左手腕上戴著一支銀色手錶。

examples.en: He hurt his wrist while playing basketball.
examples.zh: 他打籃球時弄傷了手腕。

examples.en: The doctor checked my wrist for any broken bones.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查我的手腕有沒有骨折。

examples.en: May God bless you and your family.
examples.zh: 願上帝保佑你和你的家人。

examples.en: The priest blessed the new couple at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 神父在儀式上為這對新人祝福。

examples.en: We are blessed with good friends and a warm home.
examples.zh: 我們有幸擁有好朋友和一個溫暖的家。

examples.en: Dogs can detect smells that people cannot.
examples.zh: 狗能察覺到人類聞不到的氣味。

examples.en: The machine can detect small changes in temperature.
examples.zh: 這台機器可以偵測溫度的細微變化。

examples.en: I detected a note of worry in her voice.
examples.zh: 我從她的聲音中察覺到一絲擔憂。

senses.zh: 精力充沛的；充滿活力的

examples.en: My little brother is always energetic in the morning.
examples.zh: 我弟弟早上總是精力充沛。

examples.en: The coach asked the team to stay energetic until the end.
examples.zh: 教練要求球隊一直到比賽結束都要保持活力。

examples.en: She gave an energetic speech to the new students.
examples.zh: 她對新生發表了一場充滿活力的演講。

examples.en: It was too foggy to see the road.
examples.zh: 霧太濃了，看不清楚路。

examples.en: The flight was delayed because of the foggy weather.
examples.zh: 因為起霧的天氣，班機延誤了。

examples.en: My memory of that day is still foggy.
examples.zh: 我對那天的記憶仍然很模糊。

examples.en: She ran to hug her mother at the airport.
examples.zh: 她在機場跑過去擁抱媽媽。

examples.en: The little girl hugged her teddy bear tightly.
examples.zh: 小女孩緊緊抱著她的泰迪熊。

examples.en: Friends hugged each other after the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 畢業典禮後，朋友們互相擁抱。

examples.en: Give your grandma a big hug.
examples.zh: 給奶奶一個大大的擁抱。

examples.en: A warm hug made him feel better.
examples.zh: 一個溫暖的擁抱讓他覺得好多了。

examples.en: The two sisters shared a long hug at the station.
examples.zh: 兩姊妹在車站相擁了好久。

examples.en: Would you like a slice of cake?
examples.zh: 你想吃一片蛋糕嗎？

examples.en: Put a slice of cheese on the bread.
examples.zh: 在麵包上放一片起司。

examples.en: He ate three slices of watermelon.
examples.zh: 他吃了三片西瓜。

examples.en: Please slice the tomatoes for the salad.
examples.zh: 請把番茄切片做沙拉。

examples.en: Dad sliced the bread with a sharp knife.
examples.zh: 爸爸用一把鋒利的刀把麵包切片。

examples.en: Slice the apple into thin pieces.
examples.zh: 把蘋果切成薄片。

examples.en: Don't yell at your little sister.
examples.zh: 不要對你妹妹大吼大叫。

examples.en: The fans yelled loudly when their team scored.
examples.zh: 球迷在自己的球隊得分時大聲歡呼。

examples.en: He yelled for help when the bus door closed.
examples.zh: 公車門關上時，他大聲呼救。

examples.en: We heard a loud yell from the playground.
examples.zh: 我們聽到操場傳來一聲大喊。

examples.en: She let out a yell of joy when she won.
examples.zh: 她贏了的時候發出一聲歡呼。

examples.en: His yell woke everyone in the house.
examples.zh: 他的叫聲把家裡的每個人都吵醒了。

examples.en: She worked hard to achieve her goal.
examples.zh: 她努力工作來達成自己的目標。

examples.en: Students can achieve better grades with regular practice.
examples.zh: 學生透過規律的練習可以獲得更好的成績。

examples.en: The team achieved great success this year.
examples.zh: 這支團隊今年取得了很大的成功。

examples.en: Being tall is an advantage in basketball.
examples.zh: 身高高在打籃球時是一種優勢。

examples.en: The new phone has several advantages over the old one.
examples.zh: 這支新手機比舊的有好幾項優點。

examples.en: We took advantage of the sunny weather to go hiking.
examples.zh: 我們趁著天氣晴朗去健行。

examples.en: The children dreamed of an adventure in the jungle.
examples.zh: 孩子們夢想著在叢林裡冒險。

examples.en: Our trip to the island was a real adventure.
examples.zh: 我們的小島之旅真是一場冒險。

examples.en: She loves reading adventure stories before bed.
examples.zh: 她喜歡睡前閱讀冒險故事。

examples.en: Which airline are you flying with to Tokyo?
examples.zh: 你要搭哪一家航空公司的班機去東京？

examples.en: The airline offers cheap tickets in winter.
examples.zh: 這家航空公司在冬天提供便宜的機票。

examples.en: An airline worker helped me find my seat.
examples.zh: 一位航空公司的職員幫我找到座位。

examples.en: The police arrested the driver who ran a red light.
examples.zh: 警方逮捕了闖紅燈的駕駛。

examples.en: Officers arrested two men after the shop was robbed.
examples.zh: 商店遭搶後，警員逮捕了兩名男子。

examples.en: He was arrested for driving without a license.
examples.zh: 他因為無照駕駛而被逮捕。

examples.en: The police made an arrest near the station.
examples.zh: 警方在車站附近逮捕了一名嫌犯。

examples.en: News of the arrest surprised the whole town.
examples.zh: 逮捕的消息讓全鎮的人都很驚訝。

examples.en: The man is under arrest for stealing a car.
examples.zh: 那名男子因偷車而被拘留。

examples.en: The audience clapped after the school play.
examples.zh: 學校的戲劇演出結束後，觀眾都鼓掌。

examples.en: A large audience came to hear the singer.
examples.zh: 很多聽眾前來聽這位歌手演唱。

examples.en: The audience for this magazine is mostly teenagers.
examples.zh: 這本雜誌的讀者大多是青少年。

senses.zh: 知道的；察覺到的；有意識的

examples.en: Are you aware that the shop closes at nine?
examples.zh: 你知道這家店九點關門嗎？

examples.en: She was not aware of the problem until Monday.
examples.zh: 她直到星期一才發現這個問題。

examples.en: Young people should be aware of online safety.
examples.zh: 年輕人應該具備網路安全的意識。

examples.en: The team played badly in the second half.
examples.zh: 這支球隊下半場表現得很糟。

examples.en: I badly need a rest after this long week.
examples.zh: 忙了這麼漫長的一週，我非常需要休息。

examples.en: He felt badly about missing the meeting.
examples.zh: 他對錯過會議感到很過意不去。

examples.en: My aunt works as a banker in the city center.
examples.zh: 我阿姨在市中心當銀行行員。

examples.en: The banker explained how to open a savings account.
examples.zh: 銀行行員解釋了如何開立儲蓄帳戶。

examples.en: He wants to become a banker like his father.
examples.zh: 他想像他爸爸一樣成為銀行從業人員。

examples.en: She began her career as a nurse.
examples.zh: 她以護理師的身分開始了她的職業生涯。

examples.en: Our school offers advice on choosing a career.
examples.zh: 我們學校提供選擇職業的建議。

examples.en: He had a long and happy career in teaching.
examples.zh: 他在教書方面有長久而愉快的事業。

examples.en: We chatted about our weekend plans at lunch.
examples.zh: 我們午餐時聊起了週末的計畫。

examples.en: She likes to chat with her neighbors in the morning.
examples.zh: 她喜歡早上和鄰居聊天。

examples.en: The students chatted online after class.
examples.zh: 學生們下課後在網路上聊天。

examples.en: I had a long chat with my teacher after class.
examples.zh: 我下課後和老師聊了很久。

examples.en: Let's have a quick chat over coffee.
examples.zh: 我們喝杯咖啡簡短聊一聊吧。

examples.en: There is a chat room on the school website.
examples.zh: 學校網站上有一個聊天室。

examples.en: Every citizen has the right to vote at eighteen.
examples.zh: 每位公民年滿十八歲都有投票的權利。

examples.en: The mayor thanked the citizens for their help.
examples.zh: 市長感謝市民的協助。

examples.en: She became a citizen of Canada last year.
examples.zh: 她去年成為了加拿大公民。

examples.en: He has a large collection of stamps.
examples.zh: 他有大量的郵票收藏。

examples.en: The museum opened a new art collection this week.
examples.zh: 博物館這星期推出了新的藝術收藏展。

examples.en: Garbage collection takes place every Tuesday morning.
examples.zh: 垃圾收集在每個星期二早上進行。

examples.en: Please confirm your seat by e-mail.
examples.zh: 請以電子郵件確認你的座位。

examples.en: The doctor confirmed that she had the flu.
examples.zh: 醫生證實她得了流行性感冒。

examples.en: The hotel will confirm our reservation tomorrow.
examples.zh: 旅館明天會確認我們的訂房。

examples.en: She lives in a small county near the coast.
examples.zh: 她住在海邊附近的一個小縣。

examples.en: The county government built a new library.
examples.zh: 縣政府蓋了一座新的圖書館。

examples.en: Our school is the best in the whole county.
examples.zh: 我們學校是全縣最好的學校。

senses.zh: 民主；民主制度；民主國家

examples.en: Taiwan is proud of its democracy.
examples.zh: 台灣為自己的民主制度感到驕傲。

examples.en: Free speech is important in a democracy.
examples.zh: 言論自由在民主社會中非常重要。

examples.en: We learned how democracy began in ancient Greece.
examples.zh: 我們學到了民主制度如何在古希臘開始。

examples.en: The class made a democratic decision by voting.
examples.zh: 班上以投票的方式做出民主的決定。

examples.en: Japan is a democratic country with a long history.
examples.zh: 日本是一個有悠久歷史的民主國家。

examples.en: A democratic government listens to its people.
examples.zh: 民主政府會傾聽人民的聲音。
